description: CapabilityAnnouncement::to_bytes / from_bytes (JSON). Pinned in its CURRENT form: the three optional browser-leaf fields (leaf, transport, omitted reflex_addr semantics) are Stage 4's and are deliberately absent here. Absent-and-defaulted fields (signature, hop_count, reflex_addr, allowed_*) are skipped when empty, which is what keeps pre-v0.4 peers round-tripping.
